name: Emperor crab
summary: A lagoon crab Du lịch Phú Yên says is red or yellow on the shell while still alive, with a tuft of short yellow hair. It walks forward because the claws sit at the front. No recipe was printed. A method and a price are Check on arrival.
origin: Phu Yen. Du lịch Phú Yên’s lagoon article names cua Huỳnh Đế at Đầm Ô Loan.
howToEat: Du lịch Phú Yên names it as a lagoon specialty and does not print a recipe. A method is Check on arrival. Order it with the lagoon meal. A price is Check on arrival.
where: Đầm Ô Loan. The festival article puts the lagoon 25 km north of the city. A street in Tuy Hòa was not printed. Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Emperor crab at Dam O Loan — no recipe printed
seoDescription: Cua Huynh De is red or yellow while alive and walks forward. Dam O Loan is 25 km north. A recipe and a price are Check on arrival.
